description: This file contains the implementation of a CallbackStream class that implements PSR HTTP StreamInterface, providing a stream based on a callback function.

classes.name: CallbackStream
classes.description: Implementation of PSR HTTP streams that wraps a callback function to provide stream content.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that attaches a callback to the stream.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the stream contents as a string by invoking the callback.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the stream by setting the callback to null.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Detaches the callback from the stream, returning it.

methods.name: attach
methods.description: Attaches a new callback to the stream.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns null as size is indeterminate.

methods.name: tell
methods.description: Throws exception; the stream is not seekable.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if the callback is empty, indicating end of stream.

methods.name: isSeekable
methods.description: Indicates the stream is not seekable.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Throws exception; seeking is not supported.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Throws exception; rewinding is not supported.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Indicates the stream is not writable.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Throws exception; writing is not supported.

methods.name: isReadable
methods.description: Indicates the stream is not readable.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Throws exception; reading is not supported.

methods.name: getContents
methods.description: Invokes the callback and returns its output.
